newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard wants bill passed, but no tax hikes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard wants bill passed, but no tax hikes.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday that the government had no intention of increasing taxes in response to the A$400 million budget revenue shortfall imposed by the upper house.
"We have no intention of lifting tax," Howard told reporters.
"What we do point out to the Australian public is that if the expenditure savings are knocked off, then Australians lose the opportunity of even lower taxes. It's a big difference," he said.
He said he wanted parliament to run its full course, but added that he also wanted the Senate to pass legislation which the conservative government supported and had a public mandate to introduce.
"I've said all along that I want the parliament to run its full course," Howard said.
"I also want the Senate to pass measures that the public wants."
